profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Visa
profile.summary:
I'm currently a Staff Software Engineer with 9 years of experience  focused on building the core platform and backend infrastructure that enables multiple product teams.  I create shared services, frameworks, and developer platforms that allow engineers to focus on business logic while the platform handles database connectivity, messaging, caching, secrets management, configuration, networking, Kubernetes/Docker deployments, Helm charts, and observability.
My work involves designing scalable microservices, building reliable distributed systems, and improving performance, fault tolerance, and scalability for high-traffic production environments. I also enhance developer productivity by building internal tools, improving CI/CD pipelines, and standardizing engineering best practices across teams.
I actively embrace AI-driven software development as part of my daily workflow. I use Claude Code agents together with plugins and MCP servers integrated with GitHub, Kubernetes, Jira, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and debugging tools to automate engineering tasks such as code generation, code reviews, debugging, test creation, repository analysis, infrastructure management, and development workflows. I leverage AI agents not only to increase my own productivity but also to improve engineering quality and reduce repetitive work across the software development lifecycle.

Beyond coding, I lead system design discussions, mentor engineers, and collaborate across teams to drive technical decisions. I enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and building scalable platforms that help the entire organization deliver software faster. 

I'm excited about opportunities where I can combine platform engineering, cloud-native technologies, distributed systems, and AI-powered developer workflows to build intelligent engineering solutions.



Technology Skill :  

JAVA, Golang,  Python, C Language, DB/SQL, NoSql, AWS, Oracle,  Hazelcast, Consul, Vault, Cassandra, Redis, Grafana, Angular JS, JSP and Servlet , Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus, Telepresence, Kafka, CI/CD, , Agile and scrum, Splunk, Claude agents, Github copilots, MCP, AI driven projects

Description: The WFMT system will allow Openreach to
provide a standard planning system to BTs planning

Suppliers will access their respective Job Packs (work)

positions.title: Associate System Engineer
positions.description:
Client: Idea cellular pvt ltd

Technologies : JAVA, JSP, Servlet, EJB, Web Service

Responsibilities: Designing, Planning, Development, Testing, Deployment.

Major Project: Putcare application.

The Putcare application is mainly used by retailers to send demographic details(customer name, location etc.) and to exchange SIM. Apart from this Putcare is used to verify referee details and also user can get the contact hierarchy of distributor or retailers as well as get the low balance details of retailers and distributors.

positions.description: Developed a Management Information System for a government organization which would help to manage the organization, its division offices, and their projects more efficiently.
